question: Which deposited samples belong to the CEBPA and AP-1 sources used in ES1, and do assay records identify independent genotype replicates? Can the linked BioSample records supply missing source-unit identities?
decision: Separate source study, assay and biological-unit levels before interpreting the A7 genotype-by-state question.
strongest_rival: GEX and ATAC records can be paired assays of pooled material; the separate AP-1 source does not replicate CEBPA loss.
discriminator: Join each GEO accession to its explicitly linked BioSample record and inspect deposited attribute names and identity fields; a database accession is never treated as an animal or preparation.
exposure_record: The prior GEO inventory, published findings and one representative BioSample record were inspected before this freeze. All public XML responses were acquired before freezing. No expression values are read; this is exposed metadata recovery.
biological_unit: Animal, donor or independent source preparation; unresolved at the intended comparison level.
nesting_and_overlap: GEO samples are library records and may share animals, pools, preparations, wells or parent series. No cross-study independence or sample-to-animal mapping is inferred by this parser.
population_and_selection: All GEO SAMPLE entities in the listed frozen SOFT inputs and all explicitly linked BioSample records; no outcome selection.
contrast: Descriptive comparison of deposited identity fields and sample membership against the scientific question; no gene-level or population contrast.
endpoint: Exact bidirectional GEO/BioSample identity join, record titles, SRA sample accessions, attribute-key coverage and allowlisted identity values. Biological-unit counts remain null.
methods: Validate each SOFT family with the frozen v1 reader; require one explicit BioSample relation per GSM, exact requested/returned BioSample membership and matching reverse GEO IDs. Export an attribute-name inventory and fixed identity-value allowlist, never contacts or protocol/treatment text. No expression or statistical analysis.
missingness_and_exclusions: Missing or duplicate accession relationships, invalid responses, membership discrepancies and disagreeing reverse joins stop execution. Missing biological-unit fields remain missing; no sample is dropped or unit imputed.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests or inferential comparisons are performed.
precision_basis: This is a deposited-metadata inventory, not a sample-size or power justification; biological-unit variance remains unknown.
interpretation_limit: An accession inventory does not establish replication, fate linkage, receptor activity, protein delivery, causal mechanisms or experimental readiness. Public file names are not audited expression contents.
stop_rule: Stop if SOFT identity/membership checks fail. After successful extraction, hold any scientific contrast whose units, timing, endpoint or source attribution remain unresolved; do not score expression under this contract.
amendment_reason: Extend the immutable GEO inventory to the previously unqualified linked BioSample layer. Retain v1 inputs, outputs and conclusions; no biological eligibility is promoted by accession matching.
